changelog: Full controller support. Every screen works on a gamepad: a highlight moves between buttons with the D-pad, a cursor walks the battlefield, LB and RB step through your hand, RT plays a card, LT opens it (Keep or Play), Y ends the turn and Menu opens Settings. Button prompts show Xbox or PlayStation symbols to match your controller, and touching the mouse hands control straight back. On Linux and Steam Deck the game now starts fullscreen properly.
